title: A Playlist for the Scholarship
author: Wendell Brightwater
blurb: August Galloway, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent twelve years being so careful it hurts. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the final audition.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
